Veiled Dominion / Sealed Deck

The Shinbi Tactics

The court, recast in woodblock ink.

A Japanese myth and yōkai interpretation of the Sealed Deck. The design connects each suit’s role to a distinct court, from Susanoo’s Conquest to the foundations of Sarutahiko.

The visual language

Design & artwork

Ukiyo-e-inspired flat color: black, red, ash grey and white. Court names are documented; complete illustrations were not verified.
